description:
Use this when you need a South Africa national public-holiday result. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when you need an employer, bargaining-council, school, bank, exchange, provincial or locally exchanged calendar.
What it computes: Checks a South African date against the Saturday-Sunday baseline and exact 2026-2027 national public holidays, including the 4 November 2026 election holiday and observed Sunday holidays.
Example user requests: Is 2026-11-04 a South Africa working day?
Inputs: date (date).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"date":"2026-11-04"}
Outputs: territory, territory_name, weekday, is_working_day, holiday_names, calendar_scope, employer_schedule_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: is_working_day = Monday-Friday and no exact national public holiday or observed date
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/south-africa-working-day with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/south-africa-working-day.md

date.description: Gregorian date in South Africa national 2026-2027 coverage.

name: check_south_africa_working_day

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

calendar_scope.description: National public holidays over a Monday-Friday baseline.

employer_schedule_policy.description: Employer-specific exchanges and rest days are not inferred.

holiday_names.description: National public holidays applying on the date.

is_working_day.description: Monday-Friday with no national public holiday.

sources.description: Official South African Government, legislation and Presidency sources.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: South Africa Working Day
